setting: A student talks with a writing tutor about booking help for a research paper draft.
narrator_intro: Listen to a conversation between a student and a writing tutor.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Hi. I'd like to make an appointment at the Writing Center. I've got a research paper due next Friday.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Sure. Have you already written a draft, or are you still outlining?

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: I have a rough draft, but my professor said the thesis is too broad and the sources aren't strong enough.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: That's a common issue. We can look at both. Sessions are forty-five minutes. Do mornings or afternoons work better?

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Afternoons. I have labs until one every day this week.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: I have an opening tomorrow at two-thirty, or Thursday at three. Tomorrow fills up fast, though.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: Tomorrow at two-thirty works. Should I bring anything besides the draft?

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Yes—bring the assignment sheet and a list of the sources you're using. Also, upload the draft to our portal tonight so I can skim it before we meet.

dialogue.speaker: speaker1
dialogue.text: I can do that. One more thing: can we focus on citations? I'm never sure about APA format.

dialogue.speaker: speaker2
dialogue.text: Absolutely. We'll tighten the thesis first, then spend the last part of the session on APA. See you tomorrow at two-thirty.

narrator_outro: Now get ready to answer the questions.

questions.narrator_text: What is the conversation mainly about?

options.B: Scheduling a Writing Center session for a research paper
options.C: Choosing a new research topic for next semester
options.D: Complaining about a professor's grading policy

questions.explanation: The student books a Writing Center appointment to improve a research paper draft before Friday.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing A because labs are mentioned — that only limits her available times.

questions.narrator_text: What problem did the professor identify with the student's paper?

options.A: The paper is shorter than the required length.
options.B: The thesis is too broad and the sources are weak.
options.C: The student used the wrong citation style entirely.
options.D: The draft was submitted after the deadline.

questions.explanation: She says her professor found the thesis too broad and the sources not strong enough.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing C because APA comes up later — citations are her extra request, not the professor's main note.

questions.narrator_text: When will the student meet with the tutor?

options.D: Next Friday before the paper is due

questions.explanation: They agree on tomorrow at two-thirty; Thursday at three was the unused alternative.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing A because Thursday at three was offered — she picks tomorrow instead.

questions.narrator_text: What does the tutor ask the student to do before the appointment?

options.B: Email the professor for a grade extension
options.C: Print extra copies of journal articles
options.D: Upload the draft to the portal and bring the assignment sheet and source list

questions.explanation: He asks her to bring the assignment sheet and source list and to upload the draft to the portal tonight.
questions.commonMistake: Choosing A because the thesis needs work — that happens in the session, not before.
